checks.name: freshness-basis-is-the-intersection-and-not-the-evidence-key
checks.summary: Both are recorded, and this check states which one carries the freshness claim. The evidence_key field of this record is 476d66b6d7db66b39a61ddb25c8b423e60c4bc693bb33ccc79a815a824fbabfe which is the runner component's key measured at the observation commit, exactly as the two earlier records in this lineage declared for themselves. It is recorded as provenance: it says which tree this observation was made against. It is NOT this record's freshness claim, and a gate must not use it as one. The reason is structural rather than convenient: V2-045 redefined a component key as a framed hash over the transitive key closure of its dependencies and verification dependencies, which widened runner's closure to eleven components, so almost any change anywhere in the repository moves it. A live record can therefore satisfy key equality only in the impossible case where nothing lands after the observation, and that is precisely how the M3 gate failed. For comparison, ev-v2-063-provider-live-claude-refresh declared 1df4ccb0df3b3a7925b8c3cc2a83111e83c303b6f9bb0a05b457bf22f956c4c8 and ev-v2-017-provider-live-claude declared 8d93b996c667acab6f4381a8fb1730acc1f12a85a000baa25ed21c6d270d577a; this task's two-constant edit inside the runner roots moved the value again, as any such edit must. The freshness claim of this record is the pair required by G6b: the observation commit recorded above, and the measured empty intersection between the diff since it and the published 76-path set. That claim survives an active repository, is strictly stricter than key equality where it matters, because any change to a file the exercise compiles or runs forces re-observation, and is not vacuous elsewhere. Adding this evidence file and its index entry cannot move the runner key either way, because .agents/** belongs to the task-ledger component, which is not in runner's key closure.
